title: Stay Length, Booking Window and Extension Limits by Stay Type (Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement)
content:
The reservations schedule of the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement sets, for each stay type, how long a stay may run, how far ahead it may be booked, how many respite and short-stay nights a guest may have in a rolling 12-month window, and the limits that apply to extensions. All counts are in nights or calendar days.

## Length and window schedule

| Stay type | Minimum stay (nights) | Maximum stay incl. extensions (nights) | Night limit per rolling 12 months | Minimum lead from booking to arrival (calendar days) | Booking horizon (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | 3 | 30 | 30 | 1 | 90 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 7 | 60 | 90 | 3 | 90 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | 7 | 60 | 90 | 3 | 90 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | 7 | 60 | 90 | 3 | 90 |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 14 | 30 | 60 | 5 | 90 |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | 7 | 45 | 90 | 0 | 90 |

## Extension limits

| Stay type | Maximum extensions per stay | Extension request cutoff (calendar days before the planned departure date) |
|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | 2 | 2 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 2 | 2 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | 2 | 2 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | 2 | 2 |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 2 | 2 |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | 2 | 2 |

## Meaning of each figure

- **Minimum stay** is the minimum number of nights charged for a stay of the type.
- **Maximum stay** is the maximum total nights of one stay, extensions included.
- **Night limit per rolling 12 months** is the maximum number of respite and short-stay nights a guest may have in any rolling 12-month window.
- **Minimum lead** is the minimum number of calendar days between the booking date and the planned arrival date; a lead of 0 for the Post-Hospital Recovery Stay means the arrival may fall on the booking date itself.
- **Booking horizon** is the maximum number of calendar days between the booking date and the planned arrival date.
- **Maximum extensions** is the maximum number of extensions of one stay.
- **Extension request cutoff** is the number of calendar days before the planned departure date by which an extension must be requested.

## Points of reading

- A Memory Care Respite Stay has the longest minimum stay, 14 nights, and the same 30-night maximum as the Independent Living Trial Stay.
- The three Assisted Living Respite Stay care levels share every figure in both tables.
